visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with shoulder-length black hair and a silver necklace wears a black t-shirt. She stands in a brightly lit indoor room, holding a black smartphone with a white daisy-patterned case. A black Lululemon bag and a small gray plush toy keychain are positioned in the foreground. (2) The shot changes to a close-up screen recording of a smartphone. The screen displays a camera application interface, capturing a live view of a small child sleeping peacefully in a car seat with a seatbelt visible. (3) The phone display shows a lock screen featuring the photo of the sleeping child. The screen then unlocks to reveal the home screen, where the wallpaper has changed to the same child with their eyes wide open, appearing to wake up. (4) The scene returns to the woman in the black t-shirt. She is laughing joyfully, holding her phone and looking directly into the camera lens with a high-energy facial expression.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video shares a creative and heartwarming lifestyle hack for customizing smartphone wallpapers. By setting a lock screen of a sleeping child and a home screen of the same child awake, the creator demonstrates a 'wake up' animation effect upon unlocking the phone, intended to bring joy and energy to the user's daily routine.
